# InspectReport AI

> AI home inspection report software for US home inspectors. Upload site photos, add short notes, and get a structured inspection report with severity badges, repair-cost estimates, and PDF export.

## What it does
- Turns photos + short field notes into a structured inspection report
- Severity badges on every finding
- Repair-cost estimates included in the report
- PDF export
- Live report preview while you build the report
- Estimates can be shared with clients by link: the client opens the estimate online (no account needed), can accept optional add-ons, and approves it with their name; the owner sees when it was viewed and when it was approved
- Estimates are a full document type, built in the app: line items by section (labor/material split, quantity × price), optional add-ons kept out of the total, discount, tax, deposit %, validity days and estimate number — plus a personal price book, saved estimate templates, and profile default terms/exclusions
- AI Polish tidies the wording of estimate scope, exclusions, and terms (and report wording) while keeping facts and numbers exactly as written
- Estimate share pages carry the pro's own company branding; InspectReport AI appears only as a tiny footer credit
- Commercial/building inspections: findings can carry a time horizon (Immediate / 1–3 / 3–5 / 5–10 years) and the report and PDF build a CAPEX summary table automatically; a "Commercial building profile" template is built in, and templates are managed on a dedicated Templates page in the app

## Pricing
- Free: account, reports, and live preview
- Free 7-day Pro trial for every new account: full access including PDF export, no credit card required
- Pro: $9/month flat per account after the trial — no per-inspector fees, no price that doubles after a promo period

## Who it's for
- Solo home inspectors and small inspection teams in the US who write reports from field photos and notes
- Home-repair pros (plumbing, roofing, painting, tile & flooring, handyman, HVAC, electrical) who document jobs for customers — each report can be an "Inspection Report" or a "Job Report"
- Commercial and building inspectors writing property condition assessments (PCA-style reports with time horizons and a CAPEX summary)
